title: Dashboards and alerts for quality drops

videos.script: The floor release was found by reading the week afterwards. A dashboard and an alert find the next one while it happens. {{why}} The quality panel: refusals every twelve hours, with the volume beside them and the release marked. A window holds a dozen to thirty replies, and one refusal moves it by several points. {{panel}} The same numbers as counters, labelled by feature, release and outcome. Never by user, never by question. {{counters}} Then four rules for one alert, run over the week. The last hour above forty percent fires twelve times before anything went wrong. {{naive}} With a minimum sample it never fires falsely, and goes quiet every night while the problem lasts. Checked daily, it is fourteen hours late. {{tradeoffs}} The rule worth keeping compares the low end of an interval with the assistant's own baseline. It fires five hours after the release, and stays on. {{wilson}} And then the loop the whole course built: alert, traces, signals, cases, regression, gate, fix. {{loop}}
